svg.aria-label: 5F10 · EYELET BOARD LAYOUT — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Harvard' Model 5F10 drawing (F-EF), page 1 of 2 (the layout page; page 2 is the schematic this entry redraws) — not a trace

Heater layer: the one part of this board not established against the amplifier's own drawing. At the centre-tapped valve (V2) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into
one leg and returns on the centre tap. Which sockets sit on the chain, and the order it reaches them in, are not affected.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
